title: Updates & easier pairing
items: Settings › Updates shows your version, checks for a newer one and lists what’s new.
New “Pair phone” button at the top on the computer shows the QR code in one click.

title: Faster phone pairing
items: Quick link pairs in a few seconds instead of hanging on “Connecting…”.
Two extra relays on the normal web port, so strict Wi-Fi and phone networks get through.
The pairing screen shows how many relays are connected and tips if it’s slow.

title: Names and email sign-in
items: Settings › You & sign-in: set your name; books and items show who added them.
Optional email sign-in (with cloud sync) to join the household on a new device with a code.

title: Warranties & documents
items: New tool: photograph receipts and warranties, set end dates, link them to an item and note where the box is.

title: Pantry
items: New tool: scan food, track use-by dates, and share a shopping list.

title: Search and Reminders
items: Search everything from the start menu (press /).
Reminders: things lent out over 30 days, warranties and food running out, matches this week.

title: Faster and easier to use
items: The library stays smooth with thousands of books.
Clearer colours in dark mode and a visible keyboard focus everywhere.

title: Golf and photography
items: Golf: per-person calibration, practice sessions, impact timed from the ball strike.
Photos: full-size RAW and iPhone HEIC previews, ZIP export, compare a whole burst.

title: Sports
items: Rugby asks for the conversion after a try; line-ups with minutes played.
Cricket: wickets off wides and no-balls, retired hurt batters can come back.
